cases.description: The head of a log of four entries, issued after the last was recorded.
cases.name: head

cases.description: A log with no entries has size 0 and no last entry.
cases.name: empty-log

cases.description: Size 0 naming a last entry.
cases.name: empty-with-last

cases.description: Two entries and no last entry.
cases.name: entries-without-last

cases.description: A size below zero.
cases.name: negative-size

cases.description: A head of another protocol version.
cases.name: other-protocol

cases.description: The last entry named by a digest that is not SHA-256.
cases.name: last-not-sha-256

cases.description: The head's text is not canonical JSON.
cases.name: not-canonical

cases.description: Signed by a key the relying party does not trust.
cases.name: untrusted-key

cases.description: Signed by a trusted key of another registry than the one the head names.
cases.name: key-of-another-registry

cases.description: Signed by a key of the registry that was no longer valid when the head was issued.
cases.name: retired-key

cases.description: The size was changed after signing.
cases.name: altered

cases.description: Signed under the receipt's domain: a signature for one kind of object is not one for another.
cases.name: signed-as-a-receipt

cases.description: The held entry is the head's last entry.
cases.name: held-is-last

cases.description: The held entry is before the head's last: the head covers its position, a segment shows inclusion.
cases.name: held-before-last

cases.description: The held entry was recorded after the head was issued.
cases.name: held-recorded-after

cases.description: The held entry was recorded before the head was issued, and the head leaves it out.
cases.name: held-withheld

cases.description: Recorded in the very instant the head was issued: not withheld.
cases.name: held-same-instant

cases.description: The head names another entry at the held entry's position: the registry signed both.
cases.name: held-rewritten

cases.description: The head counts the held entry but is dated before it was recorded.
cases.name: held-predated

cases.description: The held entry is another registry's.
cases.name: held-of-another-registry

cases.description: The held entry is not signed by a trusted key.
cases.name: held-forged

cases.description: The segment ends at the head: the whole log as of its time.
cases.name: segment-current

cases.description: The segment ends before the head: a tail is missing.
cases.name: segment-behind

cases.description: The segment continues past an older head.
cases.name: segment-ahead

cases.description: The head was issued after entries it leaves out were recorded.
cases.name: segment-withheld

cases.description: The log was rewritten after the head was issued. It verifies on its own; the head exposes it.
cases.name: segment-rewritten

cases.description: The head counts entries recorded after its time.
cases.name: segment-predated

cases.description: The segment starts after the head's last entry: it shows nothing about the head.
cases.name: segment-after-head

cases.description: A log begun after a head of the empty log.
cases.name: segment-after-empty-head

cases.description: A head of the empty log, issued when the log already had entries.
cases.name: segment-withheld-from-empty-head

cases.description: The segment is another registry's log.
cases.name: segment-of-another-registry

cases.description: The segment itself does not verify.
cases.name: segment-invalid

cases.description: An older, shorter head and a later, longer one.
cases.name: heads-consistent

cases.description: The same head twice.
cases.name: heads-identical

cases.description: Two heads of the same size naming different last entries.
cases.name: heads-equivocate

cases.description: A later head with fewer entries than an earlier one: the later one withheld them.
cases.name: heads-regress

cases.description: Heads of different registries are not compared.
cases.name: heads-of-two-registries

cases.description: The second head is not signed by a trusted key.
cases.name: other-head-forged
